newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Williams sees 15 pct earnings rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Williams sees 15 pct earnings rise.

text.p: Clothing retailer R.M. Williams Holdings Ltd expects earnings to rise about 15 percent in 1996/97 to June 30 after a 14 percent rise in first quarter sales compared with a year earlier, chairman Ken Cowley said.

Cowley told reporters after the annual meeting in Adelaide on Wednesday that he believed the company would certainly be able to maintain the sales rise throughout the year, although Christmas was a crucial trading period.
"But we are pleasantly surprised at the strong performance early in the year which is against the trend," he said.
